WITH ordered_cities AS (
    SELECT 
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY geolocation_state, geolocation_city, geolocation_zip_code_prefix, geolocation_lat, geolocation_lng) as rn
    FROM olist_geolocation
),
with_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        c1.geolocation_lat as lat1,
        c1.geolocation_lng as lng1,
        c1.geolocation_city as city1,
        c1.geolocation_state as state1,
        c2.geolocation_lat as lat2,
        c2.geolocation_lng as lng2,
        c2.geolocation_city as city2,
        c2.geolocation_state as state2,
        6371.0 * ACOS(
            CASE 
                WHEN (COS(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lng - c1.geolocation_lng)) 
                     + SIN(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat))) > 1.0 THEN 1.0
                WHEN (COS(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lng - c1.geolocation_lng)) 
                     + SIN(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat))) < -1.0 THEN -1.0
                ELSE (COS(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat)) * COS(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lng - c1.geolocation_lng)) 
                     + SIN(RADIANS(c1.geolocation_lat)) * SIN(RADIANS(c2.geolocation_lat)))
            END
        ) as distance_km
    FROM ordered_cities c1
    JOIN ordered_cities c2 ON c2.rn = c1.rn + 1
)
SELECT city1, state1, city2, state2, distance_km
FROM with_distances
ORDER BY distance_km DESC
LIMIT 10
